name: zcliprect_clip_poly_near_z_attr0
description: zClipRect::ClipPolyNearZ_WithAttr0 applies near/far z clipping while preserving UVs and one attribute stream.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification remains blocked: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x47af60 reports 1391 unmasked mismatches with 72 relocation bytes masked, 4 trim nops, Binary Ninja body 1497 bytes, and VC symbol 880 bytes. functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x47af60 validates far-z all-out rejection, near-z all-inside pass-through, near-plane clipping using stack scratch arrays, interpolation of vertex XY/Z, UVs, and g_Clip_PolyAttr0, copied-back output buffers, and rejection below three vertices.
The native smoke verifies generated near-plane vertices, UV and attr0 interpolation, far-z rejection, and the no-near-clip flag path.
